title: Calculator
description: Tired of mathing points out? Push all of that labour onto online points calculator

title: Gamblers mark & fish markets
description: Fish market: replaces secondary tarot hand with shared shop. Gamblers mark: Introduces new d6 based modifier

title: Fukuzatsu+
description: Fukuzatsu, the real life balatro inspired poker extravaganza!

title: Conbini
description: Furykku is a dexterity based flicking game based on Fukuzatsu for 2-3 players. Though it does not use a Fukuzatsu deck, the rules are very similar and a full set of tarot is still required to play.

title: Fukuzatsu: Furykku
description: Card sized rules compatable to be used in conbini

title: Fukuzatsu tarot augments + quick reference
description: Tarot card augments: Cut-and-stick printable effects for Fukuzatsu rules. Quick reference: Suit themes, extended hand guide, and chip values.

title: Fukuzatsu Pocket 複雑なポケット
description: Fukuzatsu Pocket 複雑なポケット is a foldable quick reference pamphlet including some of the rules for Fukuzatsu Taured Poker (Standard and Southern rules) distilled down to the essentials. Enough to get you started on the go.

title: Soloterrare
description: Poker survival horror rouge-like using physical playing cards.

title: Attaccarat
description: An expansion for the craziest poker game that lets you attack and defend as though in a war of suits.

title: Conbini
description: A card-sized expansion for Fukuzatsu that adds a shop function to games.

title: Nijuu Ichiban Batoru
description: Nijuu Ichiban Batoru is a 1 Vs 1, blackjack inspired, fan supplement for the original Fukuzatsu game designed by Willow Jay (NeonRot). It was created for the Fukuzatsu: Secrets of Taured Jam 2 on itch.io in September 2026.  The game is inspired by Baltro, Dungeons and Degenerate Gamblers, Blackjack and the Tarot.

title: The Devil's Purse
description: Add shards of lost, potentially legendary, Fukuzatsu cards to your own deck or sabotage your opponents with cursed shards stitched into their decks. The Devil's Purse is an addition to the Conbini mechanic of the Fukuzatsu game designed by Willow Jay (NeonRot). This was created for the Fukuzatsu: Secrets of Taured Jam 2 on itch.io in September 2026.

title: Fukuzatsu: Extra Hands
description: Adds 9 extra hands and one new, simple rule for Fukuzatsu.

title: Fukuzatsu: Multiversal Tasting Platter
description: Open a Locked Box from Another World and find Tarot BEYOND the normal 72 cards. ENHANCE, EXTORT, and ADD to your game with NEW mechanics and RULES.

title: Gaffukuzatsu + the hole punch
description: Two micro-expansions: Gaffukuzatsu aims to make gaff cards compatible with the game at large. The hole punch lets you poke holes in your card.
